عَمِلٌ , as an epithet applied to a man, i. q. ذُو عَمَلٍ [Having work, labour, or service]; (Sb, K;) as also ↓ عَمُولٌ : (K:) or adapted, or disposed, by nature, to work, labour, or service; (S, O, K;) and so ↓ عَمُولٌ : (S, * O, * K:) or this latter signifies that makes much gain. (TA.) ―
-b2- And, applied to lightning, Continuing, or continual. (K.) ―
-b3- And عَمِلَةٌ, applied to a she-camel, Brisk, light, active, or quick; (K, TA;) like ↓ يَعْمَلَةٌ ; (TA;) and so ↓ عَمَّالَةٌ . (A, TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
